result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one bottom navigation item appears incomplete, and content near the bottom may be obscured by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The bottom navigation item for “Orders” is missing its icon, while the other tabs show icons above their labels. This makes the tab look broken and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add the Orders icon or reserve consistent icon space for every bottom navigation item.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card appears to be cut off behind the fixed bottom navigation area, which can make the feed feel abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation bar.
